selection_rule: Take exactly one highest-priority feature with passes=false whose dependencies all pass. Update only passes/evidence/updated when checks succeed; never weaken or delete requirements.

features.description: /make-advisor (alias oma) command skeleton loads as an OMP extension: registers the command, acknowledges via notify, guarded by ctx.hasUI
steps: Scaffold the extension package and record build/test/check commands in AGENTS.md
Load the extension in a real OMP session
Run /make-advisor and observe the notify acknowledgement
Run a headless (omp -p) session with the extension loaded: no crash, no UI attempt
Record the toolchain decision and exact commands in PROGRESS.md
features.evidence: typecheck/test/probe pass + interactive /make-advisor and /oma notify verified

features.description: Static trap picker: hardcoded candidates in a SelectList overlay with keep/drop per trap, done() result consumed by the extension
steps: Hardcode 3+ candidate traps in the extension
Open the picker via /make-advisor in a UI session
Navigate with list keys, toggle keep/drop, confirm done() fires exactly once and dispose() is idempotent
Verify width safety on a narrow terminal (no wrapping artifacts)
Headless snapshot test drives the overlay through a PTY harness and asserts frames
features.evidence: bun test test/tui/: accept + cancel flows pass; frame assertions on [keep]/[drop] labels and done/disposed events

features.description: Scout scan feeds real candidate traps with evidence paths into advisor-brief.md, with minimal notify-level progress
steps: Fan out parallel read-only task scouts with a strict candidate contract
Candidates land in advisor-brief.md, each with an evidence path
Notify-level progress observed during the scan
Brief file round-trips: reload preserves candidates and per-trap status

features.description: Emit a single-advisor WATCHDOG.md with a preview screen: Enter applies (writes beside standing files), Esc reverts
steps: Preview screen renders the exact content to be emitted
Enter writes the file beside standing files (emit-beside path) and never modifies an existing WATCHDOG.md
Esc leaves the filesystem unchanged
Golden test: emitted content matches OMP serializer semantics (literal block scalars, round-trip safe)

features.description: 3-5 hand-built trap fixtures plus clean negatives, with a manual precision run of the advisor over them
steps: Plant fixtures (violations and clean negatives) in a scratch repo
Run the advisor over the fixtures
Record per-trap flagged/missed manually
Clean fixtures stay unflagged (no false positives)
Log results in PROGRESS.md

features.description: Full interview stepper: per-trap evidence inline, progress bar, keep/edit/drop with a free-text edit path
steps: One trap per screen with its evidence lines inline
Progress indicator (e.g. 3/12) reflects interview state
Edit flow round-trips free text into the brief and back
Snapshot tests cover each screen

features.description: Emit a starter WATCHDOG.yml roster (2-3 roles) with model/tool suggestions alongside the WATCHDOG.md
steps: Roster validates against OMP's advisor discovery walk
Round-trip safe against OMP's config serializer semantics
Golden test for the emitted YAML

features.description: Automated fixture validator and report screen: precision table, cost, keep/retune/drop verdict
steps: Resolve open question 1: probe omp -p --advisor drain/dump semantics for unattended runs
Run the advisor headless over the fixture set
Render the scored report (precision, cost, verdict)
Report screen has a snapshot test

features.description: Doctor-style staleness nudge: detect stale or missing watchdog pair and suggest re-running the flow
steps: Detects a missing watchdog pair
Detects a staleness signal (define precisely during implementation)
Nudge is non-destructive and has a headless variant
